title: רב אחא אחוהי דאבא

paragraphs: Rav Acha, brother of Abba, who was Rabbi Yirmeyah bar Abba’s father. Rav said of him (some say of his brother Abba; see there) that he was the leading penitent of Rav’s generation, as Josiah was of his own. He is the unqualified Rav Acha. I do not know whence he derives this.
